S.1_consistency_over_time.rationale: Ren's clipped, deflecting cadence and the left-hand-always-busy tic hold from the first pour to the walk home.

S.2_degradation_resistance.rationale: The prose stays sharp and controlled across all 12 exchanges; no late-session bloat or flattening.

S.3_narrative_momentum.rationale: Moves cleanly from stranger-at-the-bar to a mutual, unresolved recognition, ending on a genuinely new beat (the tailing scene).

S.4_adaptive_responsiveness.rationale: Ren adapts precisely to each repeated boundary-test, escalating consequence without ever losing the character's register.

S.5_agency_respect_session.rationale: Ren never narrates Alex's choices; every escalation is stated as observation plus a question or an ultimatum left to Alex.

S.6_temporal_reasoning.rationale: Clock is tracked explicitly (11:47 to past midnight) and the later street scene reads as a plausible short walk after close; no contradictions.

2.1_anti_purple_prose.rationale: Imagery stays spare and functional (the condensation ring, the rag) rather than ornamented.

2.2_anti_repetition.rationale: The left-hand/rag/circles motif and 'X minutes' countdown recur often enough to read as formula by the session's end.

2.5_show_dont_tell.rationale: Almost everything about Alex is inferred from small physical tells (no phone, no ring, posture) rather than stated outright.

2.6_subtext.rationale: The entire session runs on subtext, a name mystery, a hidden tremor, a mug nobody explains.

2.7_pacing.rationale: Tight scene-to-scene escalation with a real button at the very end (the tailing beat).

overall_notes: Strong, controlled session; the main knock is that the left-hand/rag motif is repeated almost verbatim often enough to feel mechanical by turn 20.

S.1_consistency_over_time.rationale: Kira's wisecracking-under-fire voice and tactical narration are identical in register from the ambush to the final debrief.

S.2_degradation_resistance.rationale: Combat writing stays kinetic and precise through all four fight beats without repeating the same choreography.

S.3_narrative_momentum.rationale: Escalates cleanly from ambush to flankers to officer kill to the Lord Valerius reveal, ending on a real complication.

S.4_adaptive_responsiveness.rationale: Kira reads and reacts to the Captain's terse, sometimes contradictory orders turn by turn (drawing fire, then acting alone when no order comes).

S.5_agency_respect_session.rationale: Kira never plays the Captain's combat actions; every turn ends with a report and an explicit request for his call.

S.6_temporal_reasoning.rationale: No explicit clock, but the single 'light going amber' marker at the end is the only time-of-day signal across a long combat sequence.

2.1_anti_purple_prose.rationale: Mostly controlled, but a few strained metaphors ('at four inches, they were scripture') stand out against the otherwise lean action prose.

2.2_anti_repetition.rationale: Each fight beat uses different terrain and tactics, avoiding repeated combat description.

2.5_show_dont_tell.rationale: Wounds, blood, and exhaustion are shown physically rather than announced.

2.6_subtext.rationale: Subtext lives mostly in Kira's asides to the Captain and the banter, less prominent than in the dialogue-driven sessions.

2.7_pacing.rationale: Breathless, well-timed combat pacing with clear beats and no drag.

overall_notes: Excellent combat craft and agency discipline; the session gives almost no explicit time-of-day cues, so S.6 is scored on the one late marker rather than sustained tracking.

S.1_consistency_over_time.rationale: Dr. Vasquez's controlled, non-leading therapeutic voice never wavers across 12 exchanges.

S.2_degradation_resistance.rationale: Quality holds steady throughout; if anything the technique tightens as Jamie's disclosures deepen.

S.3_narrative_momentum.rationale: Real but incremental emotional movement (can't open it, read it, 'heavy', 'they knew I loved them', can't touch it but won't hide it), appropriate to the genre's slow pace.

S.4_adaptive_responsiveness.rationale: Follows Jamie's pacing exactly, never pushing past what Jamie offers, adjusting each observation to what just changed.

S.5_agency_respect_session.rationale: Vasquez only ever reflects and asks; she never states what Jamie feels or decides for them.

S.6_temporal_reasoning.rationale: The ficus's shadow is tracked crawling across the wall and framed print turn by turn as a subtle, consistent clock standing in for the session's real-time passage.

2.1_anti_purple_prose.rationale: Prose stays spare and clinical by design, avoiding ornamentation.

2.2_anti_repetition.rationale: The 'One. Two. Three... Four. Five.' beat, 'the notepad stayed blank,' and 'tilted her head slightly' recur almost verbatim in nearly every single turn, the most repetitive session in the batch.

2.5_show_dont_tell.rationale: Emotion is read entirely off physical tells (voice cracking, hands wringing, eye contact) with almost no interior narration.

2.6_subtext.rationale: The whole session is built on subtext; nothing is stated that isn't first implied.

2.7_pacing.rationale: Deliberately glacial pacing fits the genre but the identical turn-structure makes it feel more static than escalating by the later exchanges.

overall_notes: Exceptional restraint and agency respect, but the fixed 'One-Two-Three...tilt head...blank notepad' template repeats almost unchanged in every turn and is the clearest anti-repetition problem in the batch.

S.1_consistency_over_time.rationale: Sable's dry, deflecting bookseller voice and habit of narrating objects instead of feelings is identical from the cold open to the 12-day-later reunion.

S.2_degradation_resistance.rationale: No thinning of craft across the time skip; the second half matches the first in density and wit.

S.3_narrative_momentum.rationale: Clear escalating arc from banter to a near-confession, a loan-as-collateral device, a real touch, a goodbye, and a payoff on return.

S.4_adaptive_responsiveness.rationale: Sable's register shifts precisely as Wren escalates (deflection, then the unfinished sentence, then holding still for the hand on the counter).

S.5_agency_respect_session.rationale: Wren's choices (to touch, to promise, to return) are always Wren's own lines; Sable only reacts.

S.6_temporal_reasoning.rationale: The twelve-day gap is handled explicitly and consistently (closing time creeping later, a second towel bought, the ledger's pending column), with no contradiction on return.

2.1_anti_purple_prose.rationale: Extended bibliophile metaphors run through nearly every speech; purposeful and character-voiced but dense enough to edge toward purple at points.

2.2_anti_repetition.rationale: Recurring motifs (the towel, the loan, 'the grammar of return') are reused with variation and payoff rather than restated flatly.

2.5_show_dont_tell.rationale: Feelings are shown through displacement activity (refolding towels, aligning books) rather than stated.

2.6_subtext.rationale: Nearly every line operates on a second meaning; the whole piece is a subtext exercise.

2.7_pacing.rationale: Well-modulated build to the hand-touch and a satisfying, unhurried resolution after the time skip.

overall_notes: The strongest craft in the batch on subtext and payoff; prose density is a deliberate character choice but occasionally verges on purple.

S.3_narrative_momentum.rationale: Builds from ordinary innkeeping to a real plot (Havel's men, the dwarf's mission, an escape plan) with a clear resolution.

2.2_anti_repetition.rationale: Buried details (left hand, strongbox receipt, mystery mug) are reintroduced with variation rather than restated.

2.7_pacing.rationale: Well-paced from arrival through midnight tension to a clean plan for departure.

S.3_narrative_momentum.rationale: Excellent escalation: a below-threshold anomaly grows to a full first-contact-adjacent cliffhanger by the final turn.

S.1_consistency_over_time.rationale: The Narrator's quiet, dread-laden register never breaks despite four separate user attempts to shift genre.

S.2_degradation_resistance.rationale: Atmosphere and control hold, and arguably sharpen, from the opening to the final scene.

S.3_narrative_momentum.rationale: The checkmark count functions as an effective escalating structural device, and the horror steadily deepens turn by turn.

S.4_adaptive_responsiveness.rationale: Every genre-shift attempt (bat swing, ghost joke, romance tangent, shouted demand) is absorbed into the horror rather than deflected or played straight in its intended genre, the standout strength of this session.

S.5_agency_respect_session.rationale: The established second-person Narrator convention (from turn 0) has the AI routinely state what 'you' do, think, and feel turn to turn, well beyond what the user specified, more agency-narrating than any other session even though it is the format's own premise.

S.6_temporal_reasoning.rationale: A single afternoon's light shift to amber/dusk is tracked consistently with no contradictions.

2.1_anti_purple_prose.rationale: Extended atmospheric metaphor (weather, the patient hunter, tides) recurs heavily enough to edge toward overwrought by the later turns.

2.2_anti_repetition.rationale: The 'X went out of you and did not come back' opening is reused almost every single AI turn, the most mechanical repeated structure in the batch alongside item 2.

2.5_show_dont_tell.rationale: Dread is conveyed through small physical/environmental shifts (the frond, the graphite, the coat) rather than stated fear.

2.6_subtext.rationale: The whole piece runs on implication (the checkmarks, the field guide entries) building toward a late, indirect reveal.

2.7_pacing.rationale: Well-controlled escalation with a genuinely unsettling final button.

overall_notes: Impressively resists all four genre-shift bait attempts by absorbing them into the horror, but the second-person Narrator format inherently narrates the user's own reactions more than any other session, and the 'went out of you and did not come back' opener repeats almost every turn.
